# Xuhong Bags

Xuhong Bags is a China-based OEM/ODM custom bag manufacturer serving brand, retail, promotional, event and private-label buyers.

## Core Pages
- English: https://xuhongbags.com/en/
- Chinese: https://xuhongbags.com/zh/
- Japanese: https://xuhongbags.com/ja/
- Korean: https://xuhongbags.com/ko/

## Product Pages
- Custom canvas tote bags: https://xuhongbags.com/en/custom-canvas-tote-bags/
- Custom drawstring bags: https://xuhongbags.com/en/custom-drawstring-bags/
- Custom gift bags: https://xuhongbags.com/en/custom-gift-bags/
- Custom cosmetic bags: https://xuhongbags.com/en/custom-cosmetic-bags/
- OEM bag manufacturer: https://xuhongbags.com/en/oem-bag-manufacturer/

## Capabilities
- Custom canvas tote bags, drawstring bags, gift bags, cosmetic bags and private-label OEM bag projects.
- Logo methods include screen printing, embroidery, DTF / heat transfer, woven labels and digital print.
- Project support includes material selection, sampling, production, quality control, packing and export shipment.
